name: Canberra
housing: Canberra renters live in apartments in the town centres and along light rail, and in houses and townhouses in the suburbs.

localRules.text: In the ACT the bond must be lodged with the ACT Revenue Office.

climate: Test the heating and check for draughts; Canberra winters are cold with frosty mornings.
fact: Canberra has some of the coldest winters of any Australian capital.
